summary.text: Son of Tenthredon (`tenthredon-magnesia`) and swift captain of the Magnetes who dwelt about Peneius and Pelion, covered with waving forests — forty black ships in the Catalogue of Ships.

story.text: Nestor's muster-roll names Prothous son of Tenthredon leader of the Magnetes beside the fair-flowing Peneius and forested Pelion. Forty black ships followed the swift captain — a namesake of the wooer from Same and of other Prothous figures in the mythographers, but Homer fixes this man among the Thessalian lords who sailed to Ilios.
